source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As your Movement phase starts, choose one option; its **Vowed objectives** last until your next Movement phase starts:

- **Defensive Footing**: one objective you control becomes your **Vowed objective**.
- **Aggressive Push**: one or more objectives you do not control each become a **Vowed objective** of yours; any rule about being in range of the **Vowed objective** then applies when a unit or model is in range of at least one of them.

Attacks by your **DEATHWING INFANTRY** units against a unit in range of any of your **Vowed objectives** get +1 to **Wound rolls**.
